query: Milvus on K8s with data and idx node split

query: MTEB scoreboard bge-large vs e5-base retrieval cost

query: SPLADE sparse retrieval vs hand-tuned synonym list med search

query: Lucene FST for suggest comp RAM footprint shrink

query: Quickwit cold log on S3 with tantivy columnar backend

query: Cohere embed-v3 vs ada-002 multilingual recall@10 lift

query: noisy-channel model vs trie-only spell correction precision

query: ES _msearch vs serial loop dashboard tail latency drop

query: OS Search Pipelines processor chain hybrid rerank script

query: recall@10 past 0.95 milestone LLM ans gen rollout date

query: Go billing svc slog vs logrus JSON handler migration

query: zap SugaredLogger vs typed Logger API boundary alloc rule

query: Pino vs bunyan Node ingest gw worker thread transport

query: structlog proc chain JSONRenderer vs ConsoleRenderer dev swap

query: log level ladder TRACE DEBUG INFO WARN ERROR convention

query: zap NewSamplerWithOptions DEBUG log sampling prod noise drop

query: OTel vs OpenCensus migration shim stats.Record cutover Q1

query: OTel semconv http.request.method replacing legacy http.method attr

query: W3C traceparent tracestate vs b3 header propagation rule
positive: Trace context propagation uses W3C traceparent and tracestate headers only; the legacy b3 single header is still parsed inbound but never emitted outbound.

query: office bird monitor reflection noise msg
positive: Office bird outside the south window keeps mistaking the monitor reflection for a rival again.

query: Prom client_golang per-pkg registerer vs default registry

query: RED metrics MW rate errors duration histogram SLO buckets
positive: RED metrics for every HTTP handler emit through a single middleware: Rate counter, Errors counter, Duration histogram with the standard 8 buckets pinned to our SLO.

query: USE metrics worker pool utilisation saturation errors gauges

query: correlation ID via ctx.Context typed key across HTTP DB SQL

query: X-Request-Id minted at edge proxy downstream echo rule

query: structlog proc redact password token secret auth cookie regex
positive: Log redaction lives in a structlog processor that walks the event dict and masks any key matching (?i)(password|token|secret|authorization|cookie); the mask preserves length for log shape.

query: DEBUG flag toggle /var/run hot reload soft expiry 1hr
positive: A debug-flag toggle reads from /var/run/debug.flag every thirty seconds; flipping the file raises the package level to DEBUG without a restart, and a soft expiry resets it after an hour.

query: Go build tag //go:build dev verbose log compile-out release
positive: Dev-only logging uses a build tag in Go: files behind //go:build dev compile out of release binaries entirely so the verbose request-body dumps can't leak into prod.

query: SIGHUP hot-reload logging.yaml zap AtomicLevel.SetLevel

query: OTel BatchSpanProcessor OTLP gRPC ring buffer backpressure
positive: OpenTelemetry's BatchSpanProcessor exports over OTLP gRPC to a local agent; the in-process exporter ring buffer holds 2048 spans and drops oldest under back-pressure.

query: HTTP span names route tpl vs materialised path low cardinality
positive: Span names follow a low-cardinality rule: HTTP spans use the route template, not the materialised path, so /users/:id replaces /users/8237 in the trace catalogue.

query: Sentry SDK init traces_sample_rate before_send PII scrub hook
positive: Sentry SDK init runs once in main with traces_sample_rate pulled from env; the before_send hook scrubs PII fields and drops handled-domain errors so noise stays tractable.

query: OTel auto-instr Python http.client psycopg only fw disabled
positive: OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for Python runs only for stdlib http.client and psycopg; framework instrumentation was disabled after a duplicate-span bug doubled the gateway latency view.

query: Jaeger to OTel SDK swap UDP thrift to OTLP HTTP
positive: Switched from Jaeger client to the OpenTelemetry SDK in 2026-02; Jaeger's UDP thrift exporter was dropping spans on the noisy worker host so OTLP HTTP became the new default.

query: histogram bucket pow-of-2 5ms to 10s SLO quantile layout

query: span event vs log line decision rule cross-svc searchable

query: slog handler trace.SpanContextFromContext Loki log-to-trace pivot

query: exemplars on histogram via otelprom bridge Grafana trace pivot
positive: Exemplars are attached to histogram observations using the otelprom bridge; the Grafana panel jumps from a high-latency bucket straight into the offending trace.

query: errgroup.WithContext Go goroutine ctx propagation vet rule
positive: Context propagation across goroutines uses errgroup.WithContext and explicit ctx params; bare go func() that captures a parent ctx is flagged by a vet rule.

query: zap Debugw vs printf fmt.Println lint ban build tag

query: logger.exception vs logger.error traceback preserve JSON stack

query: OTLP exporter timeout 5s BSP queue 4096 collector OOM guard

query: fallback stale Redis snapshot ES breaker-open X-Stale hdr

query: Go ctx.WithValue request-scoped trace-id tenant tag gateway rule

query: retry_policies.yaml shared Go Python SDK per-endpoint overrides

query: PoolExhaustedError conn pool in-flight waiter dashboard alert cascade

query: toxiproxy fault injection CI gate timeout fallback resilience test

query: aiohttp separate conn pool per downstream bulkhead starvation isolate

query: CacheResult union Hit Miss Stale vs sentinel None exhaustive match

query: /healthz liveness vs readiness degraded dep LB drain pod

query: graceful shutdown SIGTERM 30s drain flag in-flight refuse new

query: partial-failure 207 multi-status bulk-write per-item code envelope

query: Spring Boot WebClient vs RestTemplate Reactor Retry declarative

query: failure-mode catalogue payments svc downstream mitigation runbook gate

query: anyhow vs thiserror split Rust CLI backtrace typed lib boundary

query: etcd leader-election lock compaction job lease 90s auto-expire

query: Arrow Kotlin Either monad flatMap loan-decision DecisionError total

query: slog structured panic recovery JSON goroutine req-id stack Go
